title.en: The Jingyuan Mutiny and the court at Fengtian

summary.en:
An expected campaign reward could become a political crisis. In 783, soldiers of the Jingyuan army passing through Chang’an rebelled after receiving less than they expected. Emperor Dezong fled the capital and took refuge at Fengtian. The later Zizhi tongjian describes the hurried flight and the gathering of defenders around the court.

Read this as a story about resources as well as commanders. David Graff’s study connects late Tang soldiers’ compensation to military loyalty and the taxes that sustained armies. The episode reveals why a single imperial color on a map cannot show how precarious the court’s control could be.
summary.zh:
一次出征赏赐也可能引发政治危机。783年，途经长安的泾原军士因所得不及预期而哗变，唐德宗逃出京师，避难奉天。后出的《资治通鉴》记述了仓促出奔以及守军逐渐集结的过程。

这不仅是将领的故事，也关乎财赋。历史学者David A. Graff的研究将唐后期士兵的待遇同军事忠诚、维持军队的赋税联系起来。这一事件说明，地图上同一种帝国颜色无法表达朝廷控制可能有多么脆弱。

dateNote.en: 783 CE dates the mutiny and refuge. The chronicle uses a Chinese lunar month; no Gregorian month or day is asserted. Fengtian is represented near present-day Qian County.
dateNote.zh: 783年为兵变与出奔奉天之年。编年史使用农历月份，此处不将其换算为公历月日。奉天以今乾县附近的代表点标示。

sources.title: The Reach of the Military: Tang
sources.publisher: David A. Graff · Journal of Chinese History, Cambridge University Press
sources.evidenceNote: Sections on soldiers’ compensation and resource extraction discuss the 783 Jingyuan mutiny and late Tang fiscal pressures.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 士兵待遇与资源征收部分讨论了783年泾原兵变及唐后期的财政压力。

sources.title: Zizhi tongjian, volume 228: Jianzhong 4
sources.publisher: Sima Guang and collaborators · Wikisource transcription
sources.evidenceNote: The 783 account narrates the mutiny, departure from Chang’an, arrival at Fengtian and defensive preparations; it is a later chronicle, not an eyewitness transcript.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 783年记事叙述兵变、离开长安、抵达奉天与防御准备；属于后出编年史，并非现场实录。

title.en: Chu and Jingnan along the middle Yangtze
title.zh: 楚与荆南：长江中游的政权与商路

summary.en:
A royal title did not remove a ruler’s neighbors. Ma Yin had held the title Prince of Chu since 907; in 927 the Later Tang court raised it to King of the State of Chu. His center at Tanzhou was renamed Changsha Prefecture. Jingnan, centered at Jiangling, remained a separate regional power.

The New History of the Five Dynasties describes Ma Yin’s tea trade and the offices that marketed it farther north. The Zizhi tongjian also records conflict around Jiangling and a Chu attack in 928. Waterways carried goods, tribute and armies: connection did not mean political unity or peaceful trade. These are later historians’ accounts, not a measured reconstruction of traffic.
summary.zh:
王号并不能消除周围的竞争者。马殷自907年已受封楚王，927年又获后唐朝廷进封楚国王，其中心潭州改称长沙府。以江陵为中心的荆南仍是另一地方政权。

《新五代史》记述马殷经营茶贸，并在通往北方的地区设邸务售茶；《资治通鉴》则记载江陵周边的冲突以及928年楚军的进攻。水路既运送货物与贡使，也通行军队：交通相连并不等于政治统一或贸易和平。这些内容来自后世史家的叙述，不能据此复原精确的运输量。

dateNote.en: 927–928 follows the upgraded investiture and the subsequent conflict. The earlier Chu title dates to 907. Jiangling is a representative point for Jingnan, not Ma Yin’s capital at Changsha.
dateNote.zh: 927—928年涵盖进封与次年的冲突；较早的楚王封号始于907年。江陵是荆南的代表点，不是马殷在长沙的都城。

sources.title: New History of the Five Dynasties, volume 66: House of Chu
sources.evidenceNote: Distinguishes the earlier Chu title from the Tiancheng 2 investiture, identifies Tanzhou/Changsha, and describes tea marketing. The retrospective account is not a commercial census.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 区分早期楚王封号与天成二年的进封，记载潭州改长沙府以及茶叶销售；后出的史书不等同于商业统计。

sources.publisher: Sima Guang and collaborators · Wikisource transcription
sources.evidenceNote: The 927 entries record the Jiangling campaign and conferment of the Chu guowang title.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 927年记事记载江陵战事以及进封楚国王。

sources.title: Zizhi tongjian, volume 276: Tiancheng 3
sources.publisher: Sima Guang and collaborators · Wikisource transcription
sources.evidenceNote: The 928 entry describes Chu naval forces attacking Jingnan and returning after peace. Exact strength and attributed speeches are not adopted.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 928年记事叙述楚水军攻荆南及议和返回；此处不采用精确兵力与所记对话。

reviewNote.en: This replaces a donor-only citation and clarifies the 907/927 titles. The sources are later Chinese court histories with their own political perspective.
reviewNote.zh: 此次补入原先只有捐赠项目引文的历史证据，并厘清907年与927年的封号。来源为后出的中国朝廷史书，具有自身的政治视角。

summary.en:
Could a book project outlast the court that began it? In 932, the Later Tang government ordered the National Academy to edit the Nine Classics and print them from woodblocks. The Zizhi tongjian records the completed blocks being presented in 953, under the Later Zhou—after several changes of dynasty.

The chronicle names Feng Dao, Li Yu and Tian Min in the project and comments on the texts’ subsequent circulation. The story brings editorial work into political history: scholars had to choose and check a text before carvers could reproduce it. This was an official edition, not the invention of printing or proof that everyone could obtain a copy.
summary.zh:
一项图书工程能否比发起它的朝廷存续更久？932年，后唐命国子监校定九经、雕版印行。《资治通鉴》记载，版刻完成并呈献时已是953年的后周，中间经历了数次王朝更替。

编年史在这项工程中提到冯道、李愚和田敏，并评论经书此后的传播。故事把校勘工作放回政治史：学者须先选择、核对文本，刻工才能复制。这是一次官刻工程，不是印刷术的发明，也不能证明人人都能获得书本。

dateNote.en: 932 marks the order to edit and print; 953 marks the recorded presentation of the completed blocks. The Luoyang point represents the Later Tang court at the start, not every workshop over the full interval.
dateNote.zh: 932年为校定与刊刻命令之年，953年为史书记载版成进献之年。洛阳点位代表启动时的后唐朝廷，并非整个期间所有刻印工场的位置。

title.en: The debate on salt and iron

summary.en:
Who should pay for frontier garrisons—and what should government sell? In 81 BCE, officials and selected scholars debated the Han state’s economic policies. In the transmitted Discourses on Salt and Iron, the government’s spokesman defends monopolies as a way to fund frontier expenditure. His critics say profit-seeking government burdens households and draws people away from farming.

The surviving work arranges opposing positions in dialogue. It lets readers compare arguments about livelihoods and public revenue, but it is a shaped literary account, not a verbatim recording of every speaker. Read the claims about the Xiongnu as the Han official’s case for his policy, not as a neutral description of all sides.
summary.zh:
边塞驻军的费用应由谁负担，政府又该经营什么？公元前81年，官员与被举荐的学者讨论汉朝的经济政策。传世《盐铁论》中，官府发言者以筹措边费为理由维护专卖；批评者则认为官府逐利加重民户负担，使人离开农事。

现存著作把对立立场组织成对话，供读者比较生计与国家收入之间的论辩，却不是对所有发言的逐字记录。书中有关匈奴的说法，应作为汉朝官员为政策辩护的立场来读，不能视为对各方的中立描述。

dateNote.en: 81 BCE is the date of the court debate, not the date of every policy discussed or of the surviving textual edition. Chang’an represents the imperial court setting.
dateNote.zh: 公元前81年为廷议之年，并非所论各项政策的设立年代，也不是现存文本版本的年代。长安代表朝廷背景地点。

sources.title: A Record of the Debate on Salt and Iron
sources.evidenceNote: Introduction dates the debate to Emperor Zhao’s court in 81 BCE; translated excerpts present the fiscal and agrarian arguments. The atlas uses original summaries, not reproduced translation.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 导言将廷议置于汉昭帝朝的前81年；译文节选呈现财政与重农论辩。地图使用独立概述，不转载译文。

sources.title: Discourses on Salt and Iron, volume 1: Fundamental Discussion
sources.evidenceNote: The transmitted Chinese dialogue contrasts the literati’s objections with arguments for salt and iron revenue, frontier expenditure and exchange. Statements are treated as attributed positions.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 传世中文对话对照文学之士的反对意见与盐铁收入、边费及交换的理由；各项主张均按发言立场解读。
